        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):

            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and self.spy_crossed_above:
            price = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            shares = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 40) / (100 * price))

            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_lot = shares

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            price = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:

                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = shares

        self.spy_crossed_above = False
        self.spy_crossed_below = False

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            prior_close = self.previous_spy_close
            prior_ma = self.previous_spy_ma

            self.spy_closes.Add(close)

            current_ma = None

                    self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(self.ma_period)

                self.spy_crossed_below = prior_close >= prior_ma and close < current_ma

            self.previous_spy_close = close
            self.previous_spy_ma = current_ma

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            close = bar.Close

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(IndicatorDataPoint(bar.EndTime, close))
            self.previous_aapl_close = close

            and self.previous_spy_ma is not None
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.previous_aapl_close is not None
        )
